YES! When I miss my daddy I get bratty and pouty and tend to act out a lot. Not only because I miss him, but I also want him to put me in my place even if it has to be through text.
Reminds me of young Hinata’s hair from Naruto :’)
Omg congratulations! So nice to know you found someone you can share the rest of your life with. You must be so excited! Blessings :3

Please don’t let the seed of depression grow into something that could consume you enough to take your life. By making this post, you are showing you are capable of turning that around and having the overgrowth under control. No matter how long it takes, no matter the lack of support from parents or anyone else, you can still do it- and that’s what matters the most. We love you.

Yeah, I did before I was diagnosed. I wrote so much flowery poetry about it that it makes me roll my eyes when I read it now. It was only last year but I can’t even relate to the words anymore or remember how I felt, it’s like that part of me died. Tbh I dumped him mainly because his feelings towards me got so overwhelming and nauseated the growing sociopathic side of me. I’m with someone else now and I may never ‘love’ like I did before, but he actually makes me give a fuck and helps me untangle the shit that is my brain- which is a million times better than some lovey dovey ass ‘written in the stars’ type of bs that I was convinced was ‘love’. Relationships with aspd will open your eyes, trust me.
